title: codonoboea pyroliflora
intro: Codonoboea pyroliflora, commonly known as a plant species, is a type of flowering plant native to Malaysia. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, making it effective in treating various health conditions such as fever, cough, and skin infections. The therapeutic actions of Codonoboea pyroliflora include its ability to lower fever, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
